position_sizing.conditional_logic: Initial lot = (balance/1000)*LotPer1000; grid levels multiply previous lot by Multiplier (1.2), capped at 3 levels per side (buy and sell independent)

custom_logic_notes: Grid/martingale EA: opens initial trade based on EMA+RSI trend filter, then adds up to 2 more grid levels (max 3 per side) when price moves against position by GridStep pips, each with Multiplier-sized lot. Exits entire grid when net profit across all positions hits TargetProfit or loss hits MaxRisk. News pause filters trades during a specific UTC hour. Market close hour blocks new trades. Buy and sell grids operate independently - can have up to 3 buys AND 3 sells simultaneously. RSI thresholds are inverted (RSILower=55 for buy, RSIUpper=45 for sell) acting as trend confirmation rather than oversold/overbought. No individual SL/TP per position - exits are portfolio-level only.
python_conversion_notes: Grid/martingale strategy requires real-time position tracking across multiple levels per side. Portfolio-level P&L exit (TargetProfit/MaxRisk) is straightforward. Grid expansion logic needs careful state management for min buy price / max sell price tracking. Multiplier lot sizing with GetSafeLot normalization (minLot, maxLot, lotStep) needs broker-specific parameter injection. News/market-close time filters need timezone handling. No individual SL/TP simplifies per-order logic but the grid state machine (tracking open levels, prices, volumes) is complex. Margin check via OrderCalcMargin has no direct Python equivalent - would need broker API margin calculation or approximation.
